title: The agreement: what is here and what is not

points.text: The largest review assembled for medical decision-making (Goyal et al., JAMA Internal Medicine, 2014; 47 clinical trials, 3,515 people) gives mindfulness programmes a small effect: anxiety d≈0.38, depression d≈0.30, pain d≈0.33 — against active controls.

outline.heading: What the course does not do
Risks named before the practice, not after

points.text: For a long time these numbers didn't exist for a simple reason: 84% of clinical trials never asked about adverse events at all (Wong et al., cited in Baer et al., 2019).

outline.heading: Who may need company for this format

points.text: Not a ban and not a filter — routing.
If the heaviness persists beyond the session, contact a living professional.
